findings.description: Flask send_from_directory exposes path parameter derived from untrusted user input without validation, allowing path traversal
findings.reasoning: The route '/<path:path>' receives an untrusted component from the URL which is directly used as the 'path' argument to send_from_directory. If REMOTES_DIR is not carefully protected or path input is not sanitized, an attacker can supply '../../etc/passwd' or similar payload to traverse directories and read arbitrary files relative to REMOTES_DIR. There is no evidence of sanitization or whitelisting of the 'path' parameter before its usage.
